answers.q1: uv (config in pyproject.toml, lockfile uv.lock). Install with: uv sync --locked --group tests --extra all. CI uses `uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all` for tests and `uv sync --locked --extra all` for pre-commit. For a full dev setup, use `uv sync --extra all`.
answers.q2: uv run bash scripts/test.sh. This runs `PYTHONPATH=./docs_src pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/`. CI runs scripts/test-cov.sh, the same suite with coverage.
answers.q4: CI runs the pre-commit workflow: `uv sync --locked --extra all` and then `uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure`. To check the whole tree the same way, run `uv run prek run --all-files`. The individual checks are `uv run ruff check --force-exclude --fix --exit-non-zero-on-fix`, `uv run ruff format --force-exclude --exit-non-zero-on-format`, `uv run mypy fastapi`, `uv run ty check`, `typos`, and `zizmor .`. For a read-only local check, run `uv run bash scripts/lint.sh`. That runs mypy fastapi; ty check; ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts; ruff format fastapi tests --check.
answers.q5: Do not edit these by hand: uv.lock (generated by uv); README.md (generated from docs/en/docs/index.md by `scripts/docs.py generate-readme`); docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html (rendered from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml by `scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors`); the language list that `scripts/docs.py update-languages` regenerates; the translated docs under docs/<lang>/ for every language except en (LLM-translated and fixed by scripts, with a check that non-English files are not modified); and the permalinks and release dates in docs/en/docs/release-notes.md that scripts add. I did not check whether other generated or vendored directories exist, such as site/, htmlcov/ or coverage/.
